summary: Converts DAT content between plain text and table form, with delimiter and blank-line controls.

key_params.name: how
key_params.note: Convert to text or to table

key_params.name: removeblank
key_params.note: Skip blank lines when converting to table

key_params.name: delimiters
key_params.note: Characters used independently to split text into table cells

key_params.name: spacers
key_params.note: String inserted between cells when converting table to text

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Delimiters are independent characters; `$%` splits at `$` or `%`, not at the two-character string `$%`.
Use Substitute DAT upstream to collapse complex delimiters into a single separator before Convert DAT.
Remove Blank Lines prevents empty rows when table output should be compact.
Converting table to text uses Concatenate With between cells, so whitespace choices matter.
Use DAT to CHOP or JSON DAT after conversion only when the resulting table is structurally stable.
key_concepts: Converts text DAT content to table form or table DAT content to text form.
Text-to-table conversion can remove blank lines before splitting rows.
Delimiter characters split text into table cells; spacer characters join table cells into text.
The How menu selects whether conversion is text-to-table or table-to-text.
